notes: The 12/12tick exploratory limit leaves effectively no timing margin at2MHz.
The 9/9tick experiment does not change production defaults and does not qualify external drive pulse widths.
Four mutation controls on separately compiled copies detect stuck counts, missing fault flags, short pulse widths and silent channel11.

Initial mutation r01 expected a later assertion; the earlier correct pulse-mismatch assertion fired. r02 isolates the timing-boundary case and passes all specified assertions. No production code was changed.
DATASHEET LIMIT entries require exact manufacturer revision/table/conditions; no generic component maximum is substituted for this unfinished board.
No complete analog-chain pass is claimed from passive or buffer models. Failed full-chain convergence remains preserved.
Positive SMD drill intersection count is a lower bound: exact tangency and process registration clearance need additional disposition.
Full r05 has17passing stages,9blocked stages and1unrun physical stage; there are no failed stages. A blocked full bench is not completed controller qualification.
Full r06 has20passed stages,9blocked and1physical stage unrun; the later11-stage stateful replay and nine-scenario mechanics integration are additional separately bound evidence.
Native electrical source/PCB remain Source26/ROOT102. No report-local reset/routing candidate is promoted here.
